messages:
infra-bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — gpu-pool-utilization > 98% and queue length rising. Autoscaler retries failing to attach nodegroup instance profile (AttachInstanceProfileRateLimit).

marta: saw it, joining. queue spike from nightly evals?

jiwon: confirmed large spike in batch jobs around 09:12 UTC, embeddings backlog growing. autoscaler logs show repeated 403/AttachInstanceProfileRateLimit from cloud provider.

sam: that sounds like quota/instance-profile attach rate limit. did we roll a launch template change recently?

jiwon: there was a launchtemplate revision yesterday to bump AMI. not expected to change IAM.

elaine: customer-impact: a handful of Dedicated slots report high latency > 4s/token and some requests are 503'ing when pool is at zero spare capacity. support triage page open.

marta: putting mitigation label. immediate mitigation options: 1) pause non-critical batch evals, 2) manually increase nodegroup desired count (but attach rate will still hit), 3) provision emergency fallback pool non-GPU models, 4) request provider support to raise attach rate.

jiwon: running script to throttle evals now: `kubectl label job batch-evals throttle=true --overwrite` and patch autoscaler config to exclude eval namespace from scale-up for 15m.

infra-bot: Executed: `kubectl patch hpa autoscaler-gpu --type=json -p '[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/scaleTargetRef/name","value":"autoscaler-gpu-temp"}]'` (dry-run).

sam: I'm going to attempt a manual nodegroup scale via cloud console to split attach calls across AZs, may reduce attachments/sec on a single control plane. Marta, want me to proceed?

marta: yes proceed, but coordinate with jiwon to ensure launchtemplate version is compatible. take one AZ at a time. notify when each step completes.

jiwon: log snippet from autoscaler: ```
E0315 09:15:12 autoscaler.go:234] error attaching instance profile: AttachInstanceProfileRateLimit: Too many requests
status code: 429, request id: 3a9b-xxxx
```

elaine: pinging support with customer impact note — some customers are seeing elevated error rate on generation requests (SLO threshold crossing), flagged for priority 2.

sam: increased nodegroup desired from 8 -> 12 in AZ-a only. cloud console accepted, new instances are provisioning but attach retries still showing some 429s. creating 2 instances at a time to avoid further rate limiting.

jiwon: while that runs, switching autoscaler fallback policy to prefer model-variant: `redwood-api config set fallback_gpu=false fallback_cpu=true` so non-GPU variant will serve lower-perf requests for non-latency-critical tenants.

marta: good. @elaine send a short customer-facing note: "We’re experiencing GPU pool provisioning delays causing elevated latency. We’ve enacted fallback routing and throttled background jobs; core product remains available with degraded perf for some workloads. Investigating root cause and working with provider."

elaine: sent to customers impacted (list attached) and created a status page incident update.

infra-bot: Cloud Provider Support ticket created: CP-78901 — reported AttachInstanceProfileRateLimit on nodegroup attach, request expedite.

sam: node boot logs showing `InstanceProfile association delayed` but nodes eventually join after 2-3 retries. we have 4 new GPU nodes in cluster, pool spare capacity up to 12%. queue drain started.

jiwon: autoscaler still logging occasional attach rate hits. proposing 15m rolling pause on evals and keep fallback routing for 30m.

marta: agreed. set incident stage -> mitigation. assign postmortem owner: jiwon. Sam, help with timeline and cloud console logs. Elaine, summary for customers and follow-ups.

elaine: noted, will provide incident update when we hit stable for 30m. current status: partial mitigation, queue draining, some 503s persisted for ~14 minutes during peak. no data exfiltration or security concern.

sam: recommend adding a gradual attach backoff in autoscaler to avoid hitting provider attach rate. filing RFC ticket: infra#3421.

jiwon: adding immediate config change: `--attach-backoff=5s` to autoscaler temp flags. rolling out to canary autoscaler now.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for autoscaler with `--attach-backoff=5s` (canary=autoscaler-canary-2).

marta: good. once queue < 20 and latency under SLO for 30m we'll resolve pager. keep this thread for handoff notes.

elaine: handoff to oncall tomorrow at 09:00 UTC for follow-up, postmortem scheduled.

marta: closing action list: 1) jiwon postmortem, 2) sam RFC for attach-rate backoff + AZ distribution, 3) infra open provider quota request, 4) elaine customer comms + follow-ups.

infra-bot: Incident status updated -> MITIGATED at 09:44 UTC. queue drained, spare GPU capacity restored to 18%.

sam: leaving note: if provider can't increase attach rate, we'll migrate to instance-profile-per-AZ pattern and stagger attach attempts at controller level.

jiwon: will own postmortem and remediation. thanks all. :pray:
